desc: Andy, wearing a red cap and tie, stands next to the TV and winks.
Jim gets up from his chair toward the TV, as Andy in a red cap walks out of the office where everyone else is sitting.
Jim clicks something on the laptop next to the TV and plays a video for everyone.
A displeased Andy stands next to a laptop playing a video of him in a baseball uniform falling and dousing himself in dark liquid from a large orange cooler jug.
Toby holds a device up to the wall, while a worried Dwight watches, writing on a whiteboard, and Erin holds tape.
Erin sticks red tape on the wall where Toby pointed, tapping his fingers.
Erin sticks red tape in the shape of an X on the office carpet.
Meredith bends over nearby with a red X on the wall beside her.
Jim, walking with Pam through the parking lot, jogs ahead and opens the door, holding it for her to pass through.
Jim, walking after Pam, jogs ahead, clicks the button to the lift, and lets her pass into the lift.
Jim puts a bag of popcorn into the microwave in the office kitchen.
Jim takes the bag of popcorn out of the microwave and rush out of the kitchen, while Darryl and a young man in glasses talk.
Dwight, sitting at the desk near Jim, places a napkin on his lap.
The people walk out of the building as Dwight waves for the bus pulling into the office parking lot.
Meredith and Kevin push each other backward while sitting in their chairs on the bus.
Erin tapes a clear bowl of candy to the railing on the bus.
A young man near Angela presses a button on the bus ceiling, blowing her papers away.
An outraged Angela, her mouth wide open, frantically grabs at her flying papers on the bus.
Angela opens the overhead compartment above Jim, Pam, and Meredith on the bus, and a stack of papers falls onto them.
Jim strides firmly past the yellow line on the bus.
Jim claps his hands and high-fives people as he walks through the bus.
A big white bus leaves the parking lot, while Darryl and a young man in glasses sit at a table outside the building.
A shot of a bus stopping for a hitchhiker in a light suit and hat, waving it down.
People pose together beside the giant chicken statue while a man takes their picture.
A worried Kevin sits pointing at a map with a pen, while a skeptical Angela sits across from him in a bus.
Dwight angrily drops the keys with a yellow keychain onto Jim's.
Dwight climbs into the bus through the sunroof, while Pam and Jim, sitting nearby, dodge.
Jim climbs into the bus through the sunroof.
Stanley shouts angrily, his mouth and eyes wide open, as Jim and Erin watch behind him on the bus.
Andy angrily pulls the curtain closed on the bus, standing near Creed and Phyllis.
A giant chicken statue stands in the foreground while a man walks toward another man sitting on the roof of a bus parked nearby.
Andy peeks around the curtain, while a woman wipes Erin's face with a tissue on the bus.
Jim climbs down into the bus through the sunroof, while Dwight steps down onto his shoulders with his shoes.
Dwight drives a bus with a stern, angry expression, gripping the steering wheel tightly.
A wide shot of people gathered around a roadside stand called "Laverne's Pies," while a man fixes a tire nearby.
A shot of a mother and daughter sharing a picnic on the grass.
Oscar smears cake onto Kevin's face with a small plate.
Kevin raises his hands up happily, his face covered in cake.
Jim and Pam scoop cake onto their forks and eat it, sitting side by side at a bench outdoors.
Pam rests her head on Jim's shoulder, smiling, as he kisses her forehead outdoors.
